items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: So, and you know Tony Klatka would give me a hand.

ctx.x: Did you ever have players in the band, the wind players come over and say, “Alan, there’s a better way to do this.” Or, “this is, on a saxophone this is just not playable very well.
I did. You know? But I didn’t know it back then. So, and you know Tony Klatka would give me a hand. But my problem wasn’t being told, I wasn’t able to hear it you know. So
I wrote piano music and tried to figure out, well okay the trumpets go up that end and the trombones — you know. And that’s what my charts sound like to me.
